wholeA.wholeCandidateDEDescription: Die lernende Person kann an ausgewählten Beispielen die Herstellung und den Bau von Siliconölen, Siliconharzen und Siliconkautschuken beschreiben und ihre Eigenschaften sowie passende Anwendungen aus Kettenstruktur, Funktionalität der Ausgangsstoffe und Vernetzungsgrad erklären.
wholeA.wholeCandidateENDescription: The learner can describe the manufacture and molecular constitution of selected silicone oils, silicone resins and silicone rubbers, and explain their properties and appropriate applications using chain structure, starting-material functionality and degree of crosslinking.
wholeA.courseAndChoiceDecision: Selected optional Vertiefung in HB topic 4.1; available to GK/LK, not an exclusive LK line and not compulsory merely because topic 4.1 itself is compulsory.
scienceArgument: The complete source clause names manufacture, structure, properties and applications and expressly includes silicone oils, resins and rubbers. The entire new body includes each of these three families and all four named content duties, using chain structure, starting-material functionality and crosslink density for scientifically reasonable structure/property/application explanations. It does not reduce the obligation to only linear PDMS and a nanosurface.

Selected examples are legitimate operationalization of family knowledge. The body does not state that every silicone is electrically conductive or that all oils/resins/rubbers share a single chain/network topology. A later treatment must distinguish linear/lightly branched oils, resin networks and elastomeric crosslinked rubber structures with their corresponding use cases; this source-content judgment does not approve a future mechanism diagram or task.

The silicone line is in the thin-border Vertiefungen block on page 34, beneath the thick-border compulsory general plastics table. HB pages 21 and 37 distinguish binding core topics from optional material and course selection. The nearby LK nanotechnology bullets and the separate adhesive deepening do not become part of this silicone cell.
wholeA.scopeHold: Supply an explicit selected silicone-deepening/program condition and exact course placement before any operative map or default target grant. New bare provenance, GK/LK tags or a shared parent contains edge cannot encode the unresolved choice by themselves.

wholeB.sourceCourseInterpretation: Optional Vertiefungen outside thick compulsory frame; no exclusive LK label in this block. Eligibility for a selected GK/LK option is distinct from actual selection.
wholeB.scientificReason: The proposed goal names all three required families and explicitly retains production, constitution, properties and uses. Functionality, chain topology and crosslinking provide a coherent explanation across oil, resin and rubber examples. The teaching boundary distinguishes mainly chain-forming units, multifunctional resin networks and suitably crosslinked flexible chains; substitutions, route and grade conditions prevent universal property claims.

wholeA.wholeCandidateDEDescription: Die lernende Person kann an ausgewählten Beispielen die Reaktionsbedingungen von radikalischer Kettenpolymerisation, Polykondensation und Polyaddition vergleichen und die Unterschiede anhand der jeweiligen Gruppenreaktion sowie geeigneter Angaben zu Initiierung oder Katalyse, Temperatur und erforderlicher Reaktionsführung begründen.
wholeA.wholeCandidateENDescription: The learner can compare the reaction conditions of radical chain polymerization, polycondensation and polyaddition using selected examples and justify differences through the corresponding group reaction and suitable information about initiation or catalysis, temperature and required reaction control.
wholeA.courseAndChoiceDecision: TH Qualifikationsphase 4.1.8, additionally elevated/eA right column, technical LK only. This is a required eA content operator, not an optional chemistry topic; operative source/placement remains conditional on exact scope integration.
scienceArgument: The complete primary Synthesen table names radical chain polymerization and polycondensation and, additionally at eA, polyaddition. The following comparison of reaction types covers monomer features, polymer features and reaction conditions as distinct aspects. This exact source aspect requires conditions comparison across those three routes. The entire new body names all three and compares example-specific conditions, with group-reaction reasons and supplied suitable initiation/catalysis, temperature and reaction-control information.

The body does not impose a false universal recipe such as all polycondensations requiring high temperature or all polyadditions proceeding without catalyst at room temperature. Conditions depend on the selected chemical system and available data. The required comparison is preserved rather than replaced by a rate experiment.

Monomer- and polymer-structure comparison aspects are retained as neighbouring source cells. The separate student experiment on manufacture of a plastic and broader laboratory execution/documentation/safety obligations are not entailed by this theoretical conditions comparison. The three existing whole route prerequisite goals remain separately bound; this source record does not automatically approve every detailed prerequisite operator merely because a requires edge exists.
wholeA.scopeHold: Bind the actual TH eA/LK target and its whole prerequisite/source support. Do not give TH GK entitlement from the left-column shared polymer content, or source proof to practical clusters from this right-column comparison aspect.

wholeB.sourceCourseInterpretation: 4.1.8 Synthesen right column additional elevated requirement level; technical SkillPilot LK only, no TH GK entitlement from this clause. Both native TH carriers hold the same duty.
completeOriginalSourceDuty: compare reaction conditions of the three polymer reaction types in the preceding context
wholeB.scientificReason: The complete primary context identifies radical chain polymerization, polycondensation and polyaddition. The new description names all three and demands explicit comparison and chemical reasons using supplied example-specific initiation/catalysis, temperature and control information. It retains the operator and its scope rather than substituting inquiry into reaction rate.
wholeB.chemicalBoundary: Chosen radical initiation, condensation handling of small-molecule products where relevant, and selected isocyanate/OH moisture/heat control are chemically valid example dimensions. No single universal temperature, moisture sensitivity or catalysis rule is assigned to every member of a reaction class. Initiation is not synonymous with catalysis.
